records.name: Pairing, disjoint supports and sector additivity on the rational sector carrier
records.inputs: Gram matrix G on Fin n -> Q; carrier vectors u, v, x, y
records.output_or_relation: pair G x y = x . (G y) with pair G x x = qf G x (the Born carrier readout); DisjointSupport; SectorAdditive; the l1 sector weight is additive on disjoint supports; qf (u+v) expands into the two pairings; pair on unit vectors reads the entry
records.admissible_substitution: Substitute only matching carrier types and supply every displayed binder; sector additivity and the symmetry set are hypotheses, not consequences; the scale is a unit choice.

records.name: Sector additivity forces an orthogonal sector basis
records.inputs: Sector-additive G (symmetric for the entrywise statement)
records.output_or_relation: G i j + G j i = 0 for i != j; a symmetric sector-additive G is diagonal; the readout of any sector-additive G is sum G i i * x i ^ 2 (the skew part is invisible)
records.admissible_substitution: Substitute only matching carrier types and supply every displayed binder; sector additivity and the symmetry set are hypotheses, not consequences; the scale is a unit choice.

records.name: Sector permutations, invariance and the generated group
records.inputs: Sector permutations sigma, tau; a set S of permutations
records.output_or_relation: permute sigma moves unit vectors forward; Invariant and TransitiveOn; Generated S is the group generated by S; invariance is closed under 1, products and inverses, so generators suffice
records.admissible_substitution: Substitute only matching carrier types and supply every displayed binder; sector additivity and the symmetry set are hypotheses, not consequences; the scale is a unit choice.

records.name: Transitive symmetry collapses the diagonal: the form is a scalar multiple of the identity
records.inputs: Symmetric sector-additive G invariant under S with S (or Generated S) transitive; a sector i0
records.output_or_relation: G i i is constant; G = G i0 i0 * 1; qf G x = c * (x . x); pair G x y = c * (x . y); c > 0 for a positive-definite readout
records.admissible_substitution: Substitute only matching carrier types and supply every displayed binder; sector additivity and the symmetry set are hypotheses, not consequences; the scale is a unit choice.

records.name: Uniqueness and nonvacuity of the selected form
records.inputs: Two selected forms G, G2; the standard form 1
records.output_or_relation: Equal once one diagonal entry is matched; proportional in general; every diagonal form is sector additive; 1 is sector additive, invariant under every permutation and positive definite; the unit-normalised selected form is 1
records.admissible_substitution: Substitute only matching carrier types and supply every displayed binder; sector additivity and the symmetry set are hypotheses, not consequences; the scale is a unit choice.

records.name: Countermodels: each hypothesis is used
records.inputs: diag(1,2) and 1 + (all ones) on two sectors; the swap
records.output_or_relation: diag(1,2) is symmetric, positive definite and sector additive but not swap invariant and not scalar; 1 + (all ones) is symmetric, positive definite and invariant under the swap (which is transitive) but not sector additive and not scalar
records.admissible_substitution: Substitute only matching carrier types and supply every displayed binder; sector additivity and the symmetry set are hypotheses, not consequences; the scale is a unit choice.

records.name: Hermitian sector additivity along the directions 1 and i
records.output_or_relation: hf H (e_i s + e_j t) expands with the two cross terms; the real direction kills re(H i j + H j i), the imaginary direction kills im(H j i - H i j); a Hermitian sector-additive H has zero off-diagonal entries
records.admissible_substitution: Substitute only matching carrier types and supply every displayed binder; sector additivity and the symmetry set are hypotheses, not consequences; the scale is a unit choice.

records.name: Hermitian permutations, generated group, diagonal collapse and the scalar form
records.inputs: Hermitian sector-additive H invariant under S with Generated S transitive; a sector i0
records.output_or_relation: Real diagonal constant on orbits; H = re(H i0 i0) * 1 (rational scalar); hf H x = re(H i0 i0) * vnorm x; the scale is positive for a positive-definite readout
records.admissible_substitution: Substitute only matching carrier types and supply every displayed binder; sector additivity and the symmetry set are hypotheses, not consequences; the scale is a unit choice.

records.name: Hermitian uniqueness, nonvacuity and the two-direction control
records.inputs: Two selected Hermitian forms; the identity; the matrix [[1, i], [-i, 1]]
records.output_or_relation: Equal once normalised; 1 is sector additive, invariant and positive definite; [[1,i],[-i,1]] is Hermitian and additive on (e0, e1) along the real direction yet not sector additive, so the imaginary direction is needed
records.admissible_substitution: Substitute only matching carrier types and supply every displayed binder; sector additivity and the symmetry set are hypotheses, not consequences; the scale is a unit choice.
